task_description: Add a navbar currency selector (next to the Eksotika Prima logo) that converts ONLY the displayed import price client-side and live across the site, from a wider currency list (IDR, USD, EUR, GBP, SGD, MYR, AUD, JPY, CNY). The choice persists in localStorage and overrides the language default (id->IDR, en->USD) while local price always stays IDR and server-rendered SEO (JSON-LD, metadata, news server price) keeps using the locale-default currency.
